content.text:
The paper run failed, so no paper was produced. `python -m asd.paper` crashed with `KeyError: 'idee'` at `asd/paper.py` line 167, inside `claims_of`. That line builds the counter-check text from each red-team entry and expects an `idee` field. At least one entry for `omni_proofreading` doesn't have it.

I didn't edit the code or the project data, and I didn't retry. The fix is probably either to add the missing `idee` key to the red-team entries under `projects/omni_proofreading`, or to make `paper.py` tolerate entries without it. Tell me which you want and I'll do it and re-run.
